scope: Read-only exact-name review of the nine corroborated AFL profile identities, including Mitch/Mitchell Knevitt.

surnameAndKnownVariantSweep.scope: Read-only whole-word search for Kennedy, Drever, Elliott, Hicks, Hodge, Butler, Murray, Knevitt and Riding across the same four identity registries. Includes Lachie/Lachlan Hicks and Mitch/Mitchell Knevitt without requiring the first name to match.
surnameAndKnownVariantSweep.query:
select jsonb_build_object(
'capturedAt',clock_timestamp(),
'project','pojoymtniryarxxunyvz',
'legacyPlayers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'team',team,'position',position) order by name),'[]'::jsonb) from beta_fantasy.players where sport='afl' and lower(name) ~ '(^|[^a-z])(kennedy|drever|elliott|hicks|hodge|butler|murray|knevitt|riding)([^a-z]|$)'),
'permanentIdentities',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',identity->>'name','provider',provider,'providerId',provider_id) order by identity->>'name'),'[]'::jsonb) from credits_sandbox.permanent_players where sport='afl' and lower(identity->>'name') ~ '(^|[^a-z])(kennedy|drever|elliott|hicks|hodge|butler|murray|knevitt|riding)([^a-z]|$)'),
'savedEconomyPlayers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p->>'id','name',p->>'name','provider',p->>'provider','providerId',p->>'providerId','canonicalPlayerId',p->>'canonicalPlayerId') order by p->>'name'),'[]'::jsonb) from credits_sandbox.state s cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case jsonb_typeof(s.document#>'{economy,players}') when 'array' then s.document#>'{economy,players}' when 'object' then(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value),'[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_each(s.document#>'{economy,players}')) else '[]'::jsonb end) p where p->>'sport'='afl' and lower(p->>'name') ~ '(^|[^a-z])(kennedy|drever|elliott|hicks|hodge|butler|murray|knevitt|riding)([^a-z]|$)'),
'commercialIdentities',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'name'),'[]'::jsonb) from (select distinct jsonb_build_object('playerId',player_id,'name',snapshot->>'name','provider',snapshot->>'provider','providerId',snapshot->>'providerId') x from commercial_billing.definitions where sport='afl' and lower(snapshot->>'name') ~ '(^|[^a-z])(kennedy|drever|elliott|hicks|hodge|butler|murray|knevitt|riding)([^a-z]|$)') a),
'aflProviderAliasRows',(select count(*) from sports_feed.player_aliases where sport='afl'),
'productionWrites',0) result
surnameAndKnownVariantSweep.conclusion: No candidate or known first-name variant was identified in these registries. Returned records concern distinct named athletes; Elliott Himmelberg is an incidental first-name token match. No Hicks records were returned, including Lachie/Lachlan.
